title: Check Over Balzack's Burrow
description: Check Over Balzack's Burrow — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Go deep into Balzack's Burrow and feel around each area. Then return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go deep into Balzack's Burrow and feel around each area. Then return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Oh hello. Who are you? You don't look like a TDA Agent. TDA? The Townston Drink Association. We are the governmental regulatory body responsible for approving and registering all drinks for sale in Townston, Dew Valley and surrounding Dungeons. I'm surprised you never heard of us. You never saw our posters?! Hmm, we might need someone new in marketing.

Well since you are here, you can do me a favor. Head down into Balzack's Burrow and throughly check over each zone. We are getting strange reports of shrinkage, as well as parties down there where everyone is invited.

Let me know what you find out. According to the name in my underwear, I'm Loremaster Vraile of Townston.

Turn-in:

You look familiar. You remind me of a singer I once knew. The year was aught-seven and the Oroks had just laid seige to Pwnston. Back in those days Pwnston looked a lot like Townston and we all only had five skills. I rode out the war dressed as Squeak Squawk singer named Prattle Teeth...

Wait, where are you going?

Objectives:

  • Feel around the Frigid Bean
  • Feel around Cryptacular
  • Feel around the Frozen Bean
  • Feel around Nether Crypts
  • Feel around The Cold Cave
  • Feel around Crypts R Us

Client level range: 55–100
